title: O tempo
en: Fog in the morning, sun in the afternoon, rain tomorrow.

paragraphs.pt: Hoje de manhã está nevoeiro em Peniche. Não vejo o mar da janela! Está fresco e húmido, com quinze graus.
paragraphs.en: This morning it's foggy in Peniche. I can't see the sea from the window! It's cool and damp, fifteen degrees.

paragraphs.pt: À tarde, o sol aparece e está mais calor. Mas também há vento. Aqui, no verão, a nortada é forte quase todos os dias.
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon the sun comes out and it's warmer. But it's also windy. Here, in summer, the nortada (north wind) is strong almost every day.

paragraphs.pt: Amanhã vai chover. Preciso de levar um casaco e um guarda-chuva. No domingo vai estar sol outra vez, com vinte e dois graus.
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow it's going to rain. I need to take a coat and an umbrella. On Sunday it'll be sunny again, twenty-two degrees.

questions.q: What is the weather like this morning?
How warm is it this morning?
What will the weather be like tomorrow?
What does the writer need to take tomorrow?

glossary.nortada: strong summer north wind on the coast
glossary.todos: all, every (todos os dias = every day)

notes.en: it's foggy. Weather uses estar: está sol, está calor, está frio.
I need to take. Precisar always takes de.
it's going to rain. Ir + infinitive is the everyday future.
